name: SalesPatriot
long_description:
SalesPatriot deploys supply chain superintelligence into distribution, original equipment manufacturing, and procurement. By embedding AI in the teams that run quote to cash workflows, we turn email chains, ERPs, websites, spreadsheets, and portals into a unified transactional layer, so critical parts reach the production line faster.

The West’s advantage depends on supply chains that work. We build and deploy the software that makes them work.
one_liner: Supply chain superintelligence for distribution and procurement
